title_zh: iPhone Duo 开启全球限购，每位顾客最多买 2 台
content_zh:
苹果官网显示，原定 10 月 23 日发售的 iPhone Duo 目前每位顾客限购 2 台。

iPhone Duo 于 10 月 16 日晚 8 点在苹果官网、Apple Store App、苹果天猫旗舰店等线上渠道开启预售。预售期间涌入量过大，平台一度卡顿。报道称，首发当日到店取货库存已售罄，部分线上订单的配送时间已推迟至明年 1 月下旬。该机国行起售价为 15999 元。

二级市场上，据中新经纬报道，预售开启几分钟后，得物平台上 iPhone Duo 多个版本的成交价突破 2 万元。其中 1TB 黑色版本成交均价为 28642 元，比官方售价高出 7143 元；256GB 黑色版本成交均价为 22085 元，上涨 6086 元，涨幅约 38.0%。

不过，目前第三方渠道报价已大幅回落，多位黄牛在二手交易平台上仅加价 3000 元，并承诺首销当天拿货。
title_en: Apple Limits iPhone Duo Purchases to Two Per Customer Amid High Demand
content_en:
Apple has introduced a global purchase limit of two units per customer for the new iPhone Duo ahead of its official launch on October 23. Pre-orders opened on October 16 across official channels, triggering massive web traffic that led to site lag and quick sellouts. In-store pickup inventory for launch day was exhausted almost immediately, pushing estimated online delivery times into late January next year. The flagship device starts at 15,999 yuan in China.

The intense demand briefly drove secondary market prices to extreme heights. On resale platforms like Dewu, transaction prices surpassed 20,000 yuan within minutes of pre-orders going live. The 1TB black model reached an average selling price of 28,642 yuan—a 7,143 yuan markup—while the 256GB version traded at a 38% premium.

However, resale prices have since cooled considerably. Scalpers on second-hand trading platforms are now offering launch-day fulfillment at significantly lower markups of around 3,000 yuan.

title_zh: PHP 紧急修复两个严重漏洞，攻击者无需登录即可远程执行代码
content_zh:
PHP 开发团队发布紧急安全更新，修复 CVE-2026-109618 和 CVE-2026-109619 两个严重漏洞。攻击者可能通过特制网络请求，在无需身份验证的情况下远程执行代码；官方确认，在 Apache mod_php 场景中，攻击甚至可在应用代码运行前触发。

攻击者可能无需账号或密码，只需向受影响的服务器发送特制请求，就能远程执行代码。漏洞存在于 PHP 核心请求处理流程中，不依赖 WordPress、Drupal 等网站应用本身存在缺陷。

一旦成功利用漏洞，就可能在 PHP 工作进程的权限范围内执行代码、修改网站，或读取进程内存中的密码、身份验证令牌和 API 密钥等敏感信息。

修复版本为 PHP 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36 和 8.2.35。官方强调，临时缓解措施只能降低部分攻击路径的风险，更新才是完整解决办法；PHP 8.1 及更旧版本已不再获得项目常规安全更新，使用者需核对发行版或长期支持供应商的修复包。

OpenAI 表示，Calif 在 Patch the Planet 计划中借助 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现其中一处漏洞，Wiz 也独立发现并报告了两处问题。维护者与研究团队、基础设施及安全服务商已协调约两个月，为披露前的修复和防护做准备。
title_en: Emergency PHP Update Fixes Critical Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Flaws
content_en:
The PHP development team has issued an emergency security update to patch two critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. These flaws allow unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code simply by sending specially crafted network requests. In Apache `mod_php` environments, the vulnerability can even be triggered before any application code executes.

Because the flaws reside directly within PHP's core request-handling mechanism, they operate independently of underlying web applications such as WordPress or Drupal. A successful exploit grants attackers the permissions of the PHP worker process, allowing them to modify site content or extract sensitive data—including passwords, session tokens, and API keys—from memory.

Patched releases include PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. Maintainers stressed that temporary workarounds offer only partial protection, making a full update essential. Older releases like PHP 8.1 no longer receive active upstream security fixes, requiring users to rely on distribution or LTS patches.

The flaws were discovered by cybersecurity firm Wiz and researcher Calif, who utilized OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol under the "Patch the Planet" initiative. Maintainers spent roughly two months coordinating with researchers and infrastructure partners prior to disclosure.

title_zh: 三星、SK 海力士升级中国工厂，拟转产更高层数 NAND
content_zh:
据路透社报道，三星和 SK 海力士正升级各自在中国的 NAND 闪存工厂，以应对长江存储的竞争及 AI 数据中心需求。两家公司均确认正在安装或升级设备，并称与美国政府保持沟通。

三星西安工厂拟转产 286 层 V9 NAND。知情人士称，该项目计划今年 12 月实现每月 5000 片晶圆产出，2027 年 12 月增至 4 万片。西安工厂约占三星全球 NAND 产量的 40%，目前主要生产约 200 层产品。三星强调，这次属于技术升级，不涉及新增产能或建设新工厂。

SK 海力士则拟将大连工厂的产品从 192 层升级至 240 层或以上。一名知情人士称，公司可能进一步申请在当地研发 300 层以上技术，为未来在美国生产做准备。

两家公司在中国安装美国设备需逐年申请许可。路透尚未确认美国已批准此次升级所需设备的具体范围；美国商务部重申，此前政策支持现有工厂运行，但不支持扩产或技术升级。
title_en: Samsung and SK Hynix Upgrade Chinese Fabs to Produce Advanced NAND Memory
content_en:
South Korean chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are upgrading their NAND flash memory plants in China to counter growing competition from local rival YMTC and meet demand from AI data centers. Both companies confirmed ongoing equipment upgrades and noted they are maintaining open communication with the U.S. government.

Samsung plans to transition its Xi'an facility—which accounts for roughly 40% of its global NAND output—from 200-layer chips to advanced 286-layer V9 NAND. The plant aims to produce 5,000 wafers per month by December, expanding to 40,000 per month by late 2027. Samsung emphasized that this project is a technology migration rather than a plant expansion or net increase in capacity.

Meanwhile, SK Hynix plans to upgrade its Dalian facility from 192-layer memory to 240 layers or higher, with potential local R&D plans for 300-layer technology. However, deploying U.S. semiconductor equipment in China requires annual U.S. government approvals, and the U.S. Commerce Department recently reaffirmed that its policy supports existing operations rather than technology upgrades or capacity expansions.

title_zh: 雷军：汽车产业如果没有安全，其他都是 0
content_zh:
10 月 21 日，小米汽车北京设计中心正式启用。雷军同日在世界智能网联汽车大会上表示，汽车产业如果没有安全，其他都是 0；所有的智能性能和创新设计都失去了意义。小米从造车第一天起就高度重视安全。

谈到智能网联汽车的下一阶段，雷军认为，竞争将更多围绕生态展开。他提出，中国拥有完备的产业链、活跃的 AI 创新氛围和庞大的单一市场，有机会把整个智能生态连接起来，走出中国式的创新路径。

雷军以小米的消费级 IoT 平台为例称，截至二季度末，设备连接数已超过 11 亿台。为了完善生态体验，小米持续投入芯片、操作系统和 AI 具身智能等底层技术；过去 5 年硬核科技研发投入为 1055 亿元，预计未来 5 年相关投入将超过 2000 亿元。

小米澎程官方账号称，澎程汽车设计展已面向公众开幕，北京汽车设计中心也迎来建成后的首次对外开放。雷军随后转发博文，确认设计中心已正式启用，并表示计划前往参观。
title_en: Lei Jun: Safety is the Foundation of the Automotive Industry, Everything Else is Zero
content_en:
Speaking at the World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference and the official opening of Xiaomi EV's Beijing Design Center, Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun emphasized that safety remains the ultimate priority in automotive manufacturing. He stressed that without safety, all smart features and innovative designs lose their fundamental value.

Looking ahead, Lei noted that competition in intelligent connected vehicles will increasingly revolve around ecosystem integration. Leveraging China's comprehensive supply chain, vibrant AI landscape, and massive market, Xiaomi aims to build a uniquely integrated smart ecosystem.

To support this vision, Xiaomi continues to invest heavily in core technologies, including custom chips, operating systems, and embodied AI. The company invested 105.5 billion yuan ($14.8 billion) in tech R&D over the past five years and plans to commit over 200 billion yuan over the next five years.

title_zh: 宝马员工争相离职挤崩系统，个别方案补偿超 65 万欧元
content_zh:
宝马的自愿离职补偿被「挤爆」，已提前停止接受新申请。据德国《商报》10 月 20 日报道，自 10 月 8 日开放以来，已有数千名员工表达离职意愿，宝马确认目标已提前达到，计划在下月中旬前完成方案处理。

此前，数万名员工收到补偿邀请，大量员工同时登录查看个人方案，曾使内部人力资源门户瘫痪数小时，系统于次日恢复。员工表达意愿不等于获准离职，这项计划要求员工与雇主双方自愿同意。

《商报》披露的个别补偿方案超过 65 万欧元，主要涉及资历较深、薪资较高的员工，不能视为普遍标准。Motor1 的完整报道显示，方案可结合一次性付款、分期、养老金及保险等方式，部分员工离职后仍可保留购车优惠。

宝马目标是在 2027 年底前减少约 8000 个岗位。
title_en: BMW Severance Program Overwhelmed as Staff Rush to Apply for Voluntary Buyouts
content_en:
BMW has prematurely closed applications for its voluntary buyout program after thousands of employees rushed to apply within days of its launch. High traffic briefly crashed the company’s internal HR portal as tens of thousands of staff logged in simultaneously to view their personalized compensation packages.

While individual severance packages for senior and high-earning staff reached up to €650,000, BMW noted these high figures are not representative of the average payout. Packages typically combine lump-sum payments, installments, pension provisions, and continued vehicle discounts.

The buyout initiative is part of BMW’s broader restructuring effort to reduce approximately 8,000 jobs across the company by the end of 2027.

title_zh: Today AI 累计融资超 2 亿美元，腾讯、蚂蚁等参投
content_zh:
据雷递报道，Today AI 于 10 月 21 日宣布，团队累计完成超过 2 亿美元融资，投资方包括 IDG 资本、腾讯、五源资本、蚂蚁集团、红杉中国、传音控股、同歌创投及上海交大菡源资产。

Today AI 由 Teambition 创始人、前豆包 PC 端负责人齐俊元创办，主打个性化、主动式 AI 助理。产品已在国内上线，可承担日程管理、资料研究、工作协助和随身记录等任务。

据智东西报道，Today 支持 iOS、安卓、Windows、Mac 和 Linux，并可连接企业微信、微信读书、百度网盘、金山文档、腾讯会议等应用。团队希望通过持续交互积累用户记忆，在用户提出需求前提供协助。
title_en: Today AI Raises Over $200M From Tencent, Ant Group, and Top VCs
content_en:
Chinese AI startup Today AI announced it has secured over $200 million in cumulative funding. The impressive investor lineup includes IDG Capital, Tencent, 5Y Capital, Ant Group, Sequoia China, and Transsion Holdings.

Founded by Qi Junyuan—creator of productivity tool Teambition and former head of Doubao PC—Today AI focuses on developing a personalized, proactive AI assistant. The app is available across major desktop and mobile operating systems, offering seamless integration with workplace platforms like Enterprise WeChat, Baidu Netdisk, and Tencent Meeting.

By continuously learning from user interactions, Today AI aims to build long-term contextual memory, allowing the assistant to anticipate user needs and provide proactive support.

title_zh: OpenAI 模型将入驻谷歌云，企业可用云消费承诺购买
content_zh:
OpenAI 与 Google Cloud 宣布合作，将前沿模型和 Codex 智能体工作流接入谷歌云的 Model Garden，计划在未来几周全面开放。

企业可通过 Google Cloud Marketplace 购买这些模型，费用可抵扣既有的谷歌云消费承诺。双方将把模型能力与谷歌云的访问控制、集中式数据治理和基础设施结合，用于软件开发及复杂的智能体任务。

OpenAI 还表示，其模型将很快进入 Google Antigravity 和 Gemini Agent，让企业在这些工具中选择不同公司的模型。微软仍是 OpenAI 的主要云合作伙伴。
title_en: OpenAI Models to Join Google Cloud Model Garden with Flexible Enterprise Spending
content_en:
OpenAI and Google Cloud have announced a strategic partnership to bring OpenAI's cutting-edge AI models and Codex agent workflows to Google Cloud's Model Garden. The integration is scheduled to roll out to enterprise customers over the coming weeks.

Under the agreement, businesses can purchase these models through the Google Cloud Marketplace and apply their existing Google Cloud spending commitments toward the cost. The collaboration combines OpenAI's model capabilities with Google Cloud's infrastructure, centralized data governance, and security controls for software development and complex agentic tasks.

Additionally, OpenAI models will soon be integrated into Google Antigravity and Gemini Agent, offering enterprises greater flexibility across AI platforms. Microsoft, however, remains OpenAI's primary cloud partner.

title_zh: 英伟达把 AI 工厂装进集装箱，DSX POD 最快 14 天部署
content_zh:
英伟达在 GTC 柏林大会推出 DSX POD：由合作伙伴在模块化集装箱内建造完整的 Vera Rubin AI 工厂，出厂前完成集成和验证，计划 2027 年初在全球交付。

按英伟达的说法，在场地电力、冷却、网络等配套已准备好的前提下，这套方案可将现场部署时间从 6 个月缩短至最快 14 天。计算、网络、布线、机架供电和液冷的安装及测试被前移到制造工厂，与场地准备并行进行。

参与伙伴包括戴尔、惠普企业、联想、施耐德电气和维谛技术等。黄仁勋表示，AI 工厂开始产生价值的节点是投入模型训练或生产推理、生成 token，DSX POD 希望压缩的正是交付后到正式运行之间的时间。
title_en: NVIDIA Unveils Containerized "DSX POD" AI Factories to Cut Deployment to 14 Days
content_en:
At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA introduced the DSX POD, a modular, containerized solution that houses complete Vera Rubin AI factories. Built, pre-integrated, and validated by manufacturing partners prior to delivery, the product is scheduled for global rollout in early 2027.

NVIDIA claims the pre-configured system can reduce on-site deployment time from six months to as fast as 14 days, provided local power, cooling, and networking infrastructure are ready. By moving the assembly and testing of compute, networking, rack power, and liquid cooling to manufacturing plants, site preparation can happen in parallel.

Key deployment partners include Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Schneider Electric, and Vertiv. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang noted that AI factories only create value once they begin training models or generating inference tokens, making DSX POD's goal to minimize the downtime between shipment and full operation.

title_zh: 中办、国办：全面实施「人工智能+」行动，支持企业主导成果转化
content_zh:
中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发布《关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见》，提出全面实施「人工智能+」行动，推动人工智能全方位赋能千行百业。

《意见》要求加速工业互联网创新发展，以先进技术改造传统产业；在量子科技、脑机接口、具身智能、6G 等前沿领域探索技术路线、应用场景和商业模式，推进产业化、商业化。

在成果转化上，产业应用目标明确的国家科技计划项目原则上由企业牵头实施并主导成果转化，鼓励高校、科研院所按照先使用后付费方式向中小微企业许可科技成果。同时，文件提出推动健全人工智能、生物技术等前沿领域法律法规，探索「沙盒监管」方式。
title_en: China Launches "AI Plus" Initiative to Drive Industrial Integration and Tech Commercialization
content_en:
China's central authorities have issued new guidelines to deepen the integration of technological and industrial innovation, calling for a comprehensive rollout of the "AI Plus" initiative to empower sectors across the economy.

The policy emphasizes accelerating industrial internet development, modernizing traditional industries through advanced technology, and expanding commercial applications in frontier fields such as quantum technology, brain-computer interfaces, embodied AI, and 6G.

To boost tech commercialization, enterprise leadership will be prioritized for national R&D projects with clear market applications. Universities and research institutes are also encouraged to adopt a "use first, pay later" licensing model for small and medium-sized enterprises. Additionally, the policy outlines plans to strengthen regulations in AI and biotechnology while exploring "sandbox" regulatory frameworks.

title_zh: 曝DeepSeek 近 1000 亿元新融资接近完成
content_zh:
据雷递报道，DeepSeek 新一轮近 1000 亿元融资接近完成，投前估值约 5000 亿元。报道援引知情人士称，砺思星深、拾象尚势两只基金均参与本轮投资，腾讯也继续跟投。

完美世界披露的基金进展公告显示，砺思星深已募集完毕，总规模为 75.2 亿元，公司认缴 5000 万元；拾象尚势基金总规模为 36.5 亿元，公司认缴 1 亿元。

按雷递获得的信息，本轮新进投资者以产业资本为主，包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE 源峰、君联资本和吉利等，宁德时代、腾讯、IDG 资本、砺思资本和拾象资本等老股东继续跟投。
title_en: DeepSeek Nears Completion of Massive $14B Funding Round at $69B Valuation
content_en:
Chinese AI standout DeepSeek is nearing the completion of a new funding round worth nearly 100 billion RMB (approx. $13.8 billion), bringing its pre-money valuation to roughly 500 billion RMB ($69 billion), according to industry reports.

The latest round features heavy participation from strategic and industrial investors, including Geely, Shixi Capital, Summitview Capital, CPE Capital, and Legend Capital. Existing backers—such as Tencent, CATL, IDG Capital, Lisi Capital, and Shixiang Capital—are also continuing their support.

Financial disclosures from partner firms reveal strong institutional backing, with dedicated participating funds raising billions to fuel the AI pioneer's expansion.

title_zh: Codex 推出永久对话缓存
content_zh:
OpenAI 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 宣布，API 现可选择 12 小时提示缓存；对 Codex 和 Work 的已登录用户，公司会永久保留缓存。用户回到旧对话，或中断数小时后继续，也可命中缓存。

OpenAI Developers 的公告解释，长期运行的智能体会在一天中反复使用相同上下文。新选项可让共享指令、工具和上下文保留更久，即使两次请求间隔数小时，仍可按较低的缓存输入费率计费。

Tibo 将这项变化列为「第 16 天」更新，并表示恢复旧会话不会受到额外惩罚。
title_en: OpenAI Unveils Extended and Permanent Context Caching for Codex and API Users
content_en:
OpenAI has announced a major upgrade to its prompt caching capabilities, introducing an optional 12-hour cache window for API developers and permanent context retention for logged-in Codex and Work users.

Designed for long-running AI agents and complex workflows, the update preserves shared context, instructions, and tools across multi-hour gaps. Developers resuming older sessions will now automatically benefit from significantly reduced cached input rates.

According to OpenAI Product Lead Tibo Sottiaux, this enhancement ensures that picking up past conversations carries no financial penalty, vastly improving cost efficiency for context-heavy applications.

title_zh: 特斯拉三季度净利润下降 43%，自由现金流转正
content_zh:
特斯拉公布 2026 年第三季度财报，营收 280.46 亿美元，与上年同期基本持平；归属普通股股东的 GAAP 净利润为 7.87 亿美元，同比下降 43%。公司当季交付 486532 辆车，同比下降 2%。

几组数据呈现了本季的业务与支出变化：

公司称，北美新车交付中超过四分之三附带 FSD 订阅，全球活跃 FSD 订阅数达 174 万，口径包括一次性购买与月订阅，不含免费试用。特斯拉同时强调，FSD 仍需驾驶员主动监督。Cybercab 已于 9 月 3 日在奥斯汀加入 Robotaxi 服务，Tesla Semi 和 Optimus 也已分别在内华达和弗里蒙特开始生产。
title_en: Tesla Q3 Net Income Drops 43% Amid Steady Revenue and Autonomous Milestones
content_en:
Tesla reported its third-quarter financial results, posting revenue of $28.05 billion—nearly flat year-over-year—and a GAAP net profit of $787 million, marking a 43% decline compared to the previous year. Global vehicle deliveries for the quarter dipped 2% to 486,532 units.

Despite the profit compression, Tesla saw rapid software adoption. Over three-quarters of new North American deliveries were tied to Full Self-Driving (FSD) subscriptions, driving active global FSD subscriptions up to 1.74 million.

On the operational front, Tesla continues to advance its next-generation products. Cybercab officially joined the Austin Robotaxi fleet in September, while production of the Tesla Semi and Optimus humanoid robot has begun in Nevada and Fremont.

title_zh: IBM 软件业务增长回升，上调全年自由现金流预期
content_zh:
IBM 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收 171.03 亿美元，同比增长约 5%，按固定汇率计算增长 6%。持续经营业务 GAAP 净利润为 21.99 亿美元，增长 26%；相应摊薄每股收益为 2.31 美元，经营口径非 GAAP 每股收益为 2.95 美元。

软件业务营收约 78 亿美元，同比增长 8%。其中，Red Hat 增长 11%，数据业务增长 19%，自动化业务下降 3%。咨询业务营收约 53 亿美元，与上年同期基本持平；基础设施业务营收约 37 亿美元，增长 4%，但其中 IBM Z 大型机收入下降 20%。

公司当季经营现金流约 40 亿美元，自由现金流约 30 亿美元，向股东派息约 16 亿美元。前三季度自由现金流累计约 78 亿美元。

IBM 维持全年固定汇率营收增长 4% 至 5% 的预期，将全年自由现金流展望上调为同比增加超过 10 亿美元。董事会另批准每股 1.69 美元的季度现金股息，登记日为 11 月 10 日，支付日为 12 月 10 日。
title_en: IBM Reports Strong Q3 Growth Driven by Software, Raises Free Cash Flow Outlook
content_en:
IBM reported solid third-quarter results driven by accelerating software demand, prompting the tech giant to raise its full-year free cash flow guidance.

Quarterly revenue rose 5% year-over-year (6% in constant currency) to $17.1 billion, while GAAP net income grew 26% to $2.2 billion. Growth was led by the software division, which generated $7.8 billion—an 8% increase—supported by an 11% surge in Red Hat and a 19% jump in data services. Consulting revenue remained flat at $5.3 billion, while infrastructure grew 4% to $3.7 billion.

Generating $3 billion in free cash flow during the quarter, IBM now expects full-year free cash flow to increase by over $1 billion year-over-year, while maintaining its full-year revenue growth forecast of 4% to 5% at constant currency.

title_zh: 代码越写越快，测试需求激增：Blacksmith 估值达 10 亿美元
content_zh:
据《财富》报道，代码测试基础设施公司 Blacksmith 完成红杉资本领投的 6600 万美元 C 轮融资，估值达到 10 亿美元。公司成立于 2024 年，为代码合并和部署前的自动构建、测试提供算力与软件。

Blacksmith 称，使用其平台的企业已超过 1 万家，客户包括 Granola、Handshake、Supabase 和 LangChain。每周验证任务从年初的 500 万次增加到目前的 9000 万次，年经常性收入同期增长 17 倍。

联合创始人兼 CEO Aditya Jayaprakash 表示，AI 工具让写代码变得容易，瓶颈随之转向验证代码。Blacksmith 购买自有服务器，在数据中心部署，并通过软件复用测试所需的重复准备工作。

本轮资金主要将用于购买更多算力。公司也面临计算和内存供应紧张，以及模型厂商自行提供代码验证服务的竞争。
title_en: AI Coding Boom Drives Blacksmith to $1 Billion Valuation
content_en:
Code testing infrastructure startup Blacksmith has raised $66 million in a Series C funding round led by Sequoia Capital, achieving a $1 billion valuation. Founded in 2024, the company provides automated build and testing infrastructure for software code prior to deployment.

As AI tools accelerate code generation, the primary engineering bottleneck has shifted to testing and validation. Blacksmith addresses this by deploying dedicated servers and software to streamline test setup environments.

Servicing over 10,000 enterprise clients, including Supabase and LangChain, Blacksmith's weekly test runs surged from 5 million at the start of the year to 90 million, driving a 17-fold increase in annual recurring revenue. The new capital will primarily fund additional compute power, though the company continues to navigate hardware supply constraints and competition from AI model providers.

title_zh: 💡 何小鹏：自动驾驶应跳过 L3，安全性还要打问号
content_zh:
小鹏汽车董事长何小鹏在世界智能网联汽车大会上表示，自动驾驶应该跳过 L3。他认为，L3 模式将安全责任转移给系统，但用户体验没有得到优化，安全性是否提高也需要打问号。

在他的判断中，L3 本质上更接近 L2 的增强形态，他看好的发展路线是 L2、L4，以及重新定义后的 L5。各国监管体系要支撑自动驾驶向更高等级演进，前提应当是安全、可管控。

何小鹏还提出，过去的 L5 定义主要从技术维度出发，没有充分从安全、场景可控的角度考量。

汽车是在一定条件下提供服务的被动式自动驾驶，机器人则可能需要 24 小时主动执行任务，因此未来 L5 的定义也应随应用场景调整。

谈及落地时间，他区分了技术和政策两条进度：从技术层面，他预计 L4 将在 2028 年下半年落地；从法规和政策角度，他判断时间可能在 2028 至 2032 年之间。
title_en: XPeng CEO Urges Industry to Skip Level 3 Autonomous Driving
content_en:
XPeng Chairman He Xiaopeng called on the automotive industry to bypass Level 3 autonomous driving, questioning its overall safety during the World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference.

He noted that Level 3 shifts safety liability to the vehicle system without meaningfully improving user experience or safety, functioning merely as an enhanced Level 2. Instead, he advocates moving directly from Level 2 to Level 4, followed by a redefined Level 5 that focuses on operational safety and real-world scenarios.

On commercialization timelines, He predicted that Level 4 technology will be ready by the second half of 2028, with regulatory and policy approval expected between 2028 and 2032.

title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet，会主动汇报并在后台继续办事
content_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Duet，将 Claude 做成会主动联系用户、持续处理任务的个人智能体。目前产品开放研究预览候补名单，先面向美国 Claude Pro 和 Max 订阅用户，提供独立 iOS、Android App 及 claude.ai 网页入口。

Duet 基于 Claude Opus 5.5，沿用用户已有的记忆、技能和应用连接。它每天早上汇总已连接应用中的重要事项，白天继续关注变化，只在需要处理或决策时发消息；用户也可交给它安排会议、制作预测表、搭建仪表盘或开发网页应用等任务，离开后它仍会继续工作。

它在云端电脑里使用用户连接的工具，产品页称支持超过 6000 个连接器和插件。涉及发送消息、付款等敏感操作时需先取得确认；Anthropic 表示，Duet 不直接看到密码和登录令牌，还加入专门的信息保护分类器，限制身份证件、信用卡等敏感信息外传。

研究预览包含在 Pro 和 Max 套餐内，与其他 Claude 使用共享额度，后台检查也会消耗额度；Team 和 Enterprise 暂不包含。官方提示，产品仍可能误读对话、判断错紧急程度，或漏掉两次检查之间到来的消息。
title_en: Anthropic Unveils Claude Duet: An Autonomous AI Agent That Works in the Background
content_en:
Anthropic has announced Claude Duet, an autonomous AI agent designed to proactively assist users and handle complex tasks in the background. Currently available via a research preview waitlist for US-based Claude Pro and Max subscribers, Duet can be accessed through dedicated iOS and Android apps as well as the web.

Powered by Claude Opus 5.5, Duet leverages user memories, custom skills, and integrations across more than 6,000 app connectors. It provides daily morning briefings, tracks updates throughout the day, and only interrupts users when explicit decisions or approvals are required. Users can offload tasks such as scheduling meetings, creating financial models, building dashboards, or developing web applications, which Duet continues to process autonomously after the user logs off.

To ensure privacy and security, sensitive actions like sending messages or processing payments require manual confirmation. Anthropic noted that Duet does not directly access passwords or login tokens, and uses specialized classifiers to prevent the transmission of sensitive data like government IDs and credit cards.

title_zh: 国补 3149 元起，荣耀 WIN2 系列开售
content_zh:
荣耀 10 月 21 日在杭州发布 WIN2、WIN RT2 两款手机，并于发布当天开售，首销国补到手价分别为 4999 元起、3149 元起。本场还带来 WIN Turbo2、WIN 平板及 WIN 耳机。

WIN2 还将推出《三角洲行动》职业赛事联名款，10 月 30 日开启电商预约，计划 11 月登场。
title_en: Honor Launches WIN2 Series Smartphones, Starting at 3,149 Yuan
content_en:
Honor officially launched its new WIN2 and WIN RT2 smartphones in Hangzhou, making both models available for immediate purchase. Factoring in national subsidies, effective starting prices begin at 3,149 RMB for the WIN RT2 and 4,999 RMB for the flagship WIN2. The launch event also featured the unveiling of the WIN Turbo2, a WIN Tablet, and WIN Earphones.

Additionally, Honor announced a special esports co-branded edition of the WIN2 in partnership with *Delta Force*. E-commerce pre-orders for the gaming-centric variant will open on October 30, with an official release planned for November.

title_zh: Flowtica 获新融资，磁吸墨水屏硬件 Verso 计划 12 月出货
content_zh:
据硬氪报道，AI 硬件公司 Flowtica 已完成新一轮数千万元融资，投资方包括祥峰资本、源码资本、五源资本和清水湾基金。其磁吸式墨水屏硬件 Verso 本周开始预收定金，首批量产产品计划于 12 月出货。

Verso 可贴在手机背面，厚 6.5mm、重 78g，配备常显墨水屏、实体按键、Type-C 接口、四麦克风阵列及骨传导传感器。屏幕用于呈现日程、待办及 AI 提炼的信息，侧边按键支持盲操录音和调用 AI。

创始人 Rian 在采访中解释，语音适合输入指令，屏幕便于快速扫读结果。按团队的产品设计，会议记录将与个人长期记忆联动，再生成待办拆解、会前简报和跟进草稿；公司此前已推出录音笔 Scribe，Verso 是其第二款硬件。
title_en: AI Startup Flowtica Secures New Funding, Sets December Delivery for Magnetic E-Ink Hardware
content_en:
AI hardware startup Flowtica has completed a new funding round worth tens of millions of yuan, backed by prominent investors including Vertex Ventures, Source Code Capital, 5Y Capital, and XbotPark Fund. Pre-orders for its magnetic E-ink device, Verso, opened this week ahead of its planned December shipment.

Designed to snap onto the back of a smartphone, the 6.5mm-thick, 78-gram device features an always-on E-ink display, physical buttons, a four-microphone array, and a bone-conduction sensor. The screen displays calendar events, tasks, and AI summaries, while tactile side buttons enable quick voice recording and instant access to AI features.

According to founder Rian, Verso combines voice input with visual output to enable rapid information intake. The device seamlessly links meeting recordings with a user's long-term memory to automatically generate task breakdowns, pre-meeting briefings, and follow-up drafts. Verso represents Flowtica's second hardware offering following its smart recorder, Scribe.

title_zh: 戴森推出水光直板夹，拉直头发时用冷凝管降温
content_zh:
戴森在中国大陆推出 Corrale CoolShine 水光直板夹，在柔性弹板之外加入可拆卸的散热冷凝管，让头发经过热夹板塑型后同步降温。

据戴森提供的产品材料，配件采用密封铜管，内部少量水在蒸发过程中带走热量，减少热量停留在发丝上的时间。柔性弹板则通过形变包裹并聚拢发束，让头发均匀受力，减少反复拉夹。

新机提供 145℃、165℃、185℃ 和 210℃ 四档温度，约 15 秒完成预热，含配件净重约 390 克，并支持全球通用电压。戴森称，与未经造型的头发相比，造型后光泽度最高可提升 154%。

产品于 10 月 20 日在中国大陆发售，提供晨曦粉和晶耀紫两种配色。
title_en: Dyson Launches Corrale CoolShine Hair Straightener Featuring Instant Cooling Tech
content_en:
Dyson has introduced the Corrale CoolShine hair straightener in Mainland China, featuring detachable heat-dissipating condensation tubes alongside its flexible copper plates. The technology cools hair immediately after heat styling, using sealed copper tubes filled with a small amount of water to rapidly draw away heat during evaporation, reducing thermal exposure.

The straightener offers four temperature settings (145°C, 165°C, 185°C, and 210°C) with a quick 15-second preheat time. Weighing approximately 390 grams with attachments, it supports universal voltage and claims to boost hair shine by up to 154%. Available in Dawn Pink and Sparkle Purple, the product officially went on sale on October 20.

title_zh: 生数科技公开 Motubrain 2.0 训练流程，计划连续直播半个月
content_zh:
生数科技世界模型团队宣布，10 月 21 日开启 Motubrain 2.0 训练全流程公开直播，计划持续半个月，展示具身模型从训练、测试到能力迭代的过程。团队表示，Motubrain 2.0 即将开源，目前尚未公布具体开源日期。

Motubrain 系列面向机器人任务，研究不同任务、场景和机器人本体之间的能力泛化。这次直播覆盖四个环节：预训练阶段观察训练规模对性能与零样本泛化能力的影响；后训练阶段提高具体任务的执行能力；Agent 任务执行阶段探索已有经验向其他任务迁移；递归自我改进（RSI）阶段则研究模型能否依据执行反馈，评估并改进自身行动。

团队称，相关研究仍处于探索阶段，具体效果有待后续实验与评测验证。官方 Live Lab 页面已展示训练损失、训练步数、模型评测曲线及 4 路摄像头入口，评测任务包括挂耳机、整理抽屉、拾取交接物品和擦白板。
title_en: Shengshu Technology Begins 15-Day Livestream of Motubrain 2.0 Embodied AI Training
content_en:
Shengshu Technology's World Model team launched a 15-day public livestream on October 21, demonstrating the complete training, testing, and iteration process of Motubrain 2.0. Designed for robotic tasks, the Motubrain series focuses on capability generalization across different tasks, environments, and hardware, with plans to open-source the model soon.

The livestream covers four distinct phases: pre-training, post-training, agent task execution, and Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI). Viewers can observe real-time metrics—including training loss, step counts, and evaluation curves—alongside four live camera feeds showcasing evaluation tasks such as organizing drawers, picking up objects, and wiping whiteboards.

title_zh: 宇树发布 H2-X「功夫传奇」，最长续航约 8 小时
content_zh:
昨天，宇树科技发布人形机器人 H2-X「功夫传奇 守护」。

据介绍，H2-X 以强劲性能提供服务和守护，最长续航时间约 8 小时，并提醒使用者安全、友好地使用机器人。该视频封面中的型号为 Unitree H2-X。

宇树官方此前公布，2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会将于 10 月 22 日举行，H2-X 在大会前一天公开。
title_en: Unitree Unveils H2-X Humanoid Robot Featuring 8-Hour Battery Life
content_en:
Unitree Robotics has officially unveiled its new humanoid robot, the H2-X "Kung Fu Legend Guard." Engineered to deliver high-performance service and protection, the H2-X offers a continuous battery life of up to 8 hours.

The unveiling took place just ahead of the 2026 World Physical AI Conference and Unitree Partner Ecosystem Conference scheduled for October 22, highlighting Unitree's latest hardware advancements in the physical AI sector.

title_zh: 徕卡 Q3 43 推出 F1 特别版，碳纤维握柄搭配专属赛车色彩
content_zh:
徕卡与 Formula 1 宣布授权合作，推出 Q3 43 Formula 1 特别版相机，10 月 21 日起通过徕卡门店、官网商店及专业零售商发售。

特别版将赛车材质带到相机上：机身包覆与赛车方向盘类似的黑色防滑 Microvelour 材料，握柄、指托和软快门按钮采用德国手工制作的碳纤维部件。顶盖、镜头盖及背带带有 F1 与徕卡标识，软快门按钮和指托右侧功能键则使用 F1 红色。

相机还新增专属「Formula 1」Leica Look，通过更高对比度与饱和度呈现赛道氛围。用户可经 Leica FOTOS App 将色彩风格传到相机，拍摄时就在取景器中预览效果，并直接应用于 JPEG。

核心规格延续标准版：6000 万像素全画幅 CMOS、Maestro IV 处理器、APO-Summicron 43mm f/2 ASPH. 镜头及最高 8K 视频录制。配套碳纤维握柄支持无线充电和 Arca-Swiss 快装结构。
title_en: Leica Unveils F1 Special Edition Q3 43 Camera with Carbon Fiber Accents
content_en:
Leica has officially partnered with Formula 1 to launch the Leica Q3 43 Formula 1 Special Edition camera. Available starting October 21 through official Leica stores and authorized retailers, this edition incorporates premium motorsport-inspired materials into its design.

The camera body features a tactile black Microvelour wrap similar to racing steering wheels, alongside handcrafted German carbon fiber components for the grip, thumb rest, and soft-release button. Distinctive F1 red accents highlight key controls, while custom Formula 1 and Leica branding adorn the top plate, lens cap, and strap.

Alongside physical redesigns, the camera introduces an exclusive "Formula 1" Leica Look color profile designed to capture the high-contrast, vivid atmosphere of the racetrack via the Leica FOTOS app. Under the hood, it retains standard Q3 43 specifications, including a 60MP full-frame CMOS sensor, Maestro IV processor, and an APO-Summicron 43mm f/2 ASPH lens.

title_zh: 《绝地求生》厂商开放 Raon-1 mini 模型，量化版可在单张 RTX 5090 运行
content_zh:
《绝地求生》开发商 KRAFTON 公开自研语言模型 Raon-1 mini 预览版，重点面向韩语对话、编程和智能体任务。模型总参数 288 亿，每次处理 token 激活约 43 亿参数，原生支持 262144 token 上下文。

它采用混合注意力架构：25 层中有 18 层使用基于 Kimi Delta Attention 改进的 RDA，另 7 层为完整注意力；团队还用 Raon-mHC 简化 DeepSeek 的超连接机制，以降低训练计算量。

官方自测中，SWE-Verified 代码修复得分为 70.8，但 Terminal-Bench Lite 为 47.0，不同任务表现存在差异。模型提供 NVFP4 量化版，可在拥有 32GB 显存的单张 RTX 5090 上推理，也支持 llama.cpp 和 Apple 芯片上的 MLX。

下载的模型权重及组件采用 Apache 2.0 许可，需先申请访问；官方托管 API 和体验服务另有条款。这仍是预览版本，规格与测试结果可能调整。
title_en: PUBG Maker KRAFTON Releases Raon-1 Mini LLM Compatible with Single RTX 5090
content_en:
KRAFTON, the developer behind *PUBG*, has unveiled a preview of its self-developed open-weight language model, Raon-1 mini. Tailored for Korean dialogue, coding, and AI agent tasks, the model features 28.8 billion total parameters with roughly 4.3 billion active parameters per token, supporting a native context length of up to 262,144 tokens.

The architecture utilizes a hybrid attention mechanism alongside a streamlined hyper-connection design to significantly optimize training compute requirements. Benchmark results show strong performance in coding tasks, scoring 70.8 on SWE-Verified, though overall performance varies across different tasks.

To increase accessibility, KRAFTON provides an NVFP4 quantized version capable of running locally on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU with 32GB VRAM. It also offers compatibility with llama.cpp and Apple Silicon's MLX framework. Model weights are accessible under the Apache 2.0 license upon request.

title_zh: DGX Spark 可组成 8 台集群，统一内存最高达 1TB
content_zh:
英伟达在 GTC 柏林大会更新本地 AI 产品与软件：DGX Spark 现在可手动配置最多 8 台设备组成集群，使用内置 ConnectX-7 网络互联，统一内存总量最高达到 1TB。

这套集群面向小型开发团队，可让多人同时连接同一模型，运行更大模型、更长上下文和多个智能体。NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher 计划本月晚些时候推出，可按单机或集群配置下载适合的模型和容器，并接入 OpenCode。

硬件方面，64GB 版 DGX Spark 将于 10 月 23 日从合作伙伴渠道陆续推出。更高定位的 DGX Station 已提供 748GB 一致性内存，Windows 版计划 12 月由合作伙伴推出，用于在本地模型与制造业专业软件之间建立工作流。

同场上线的十月软件更新还为 DGX Spark 加入 Wi-Fi Assistant，便于设备在无显示器的 appliance 模式下切换网络。
title_en: NVIDIA Expands DGX Spark Capabilities with 8-Unit Clustering and 1TB Unified Memory
content_en:
At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA announced major updates to its local AI hardware and software lineup, highlighting new multi-node clustering for the DGX Spark. Users can now link up to eight DGX Spark units using built-in ConnectX-7 networking to create a single cluster with up to 1TB of unified memory, enabling small engineering teams to run larger models, longer contexts, and multi-agent systems concurrently.

Alongside clustering support, NVIDIA introduced the upcoming Sync Model Launcher tool arriving later this month, which streamlines container and model setup for integration with OpenCode. Hardware availability is also expanding, with the 64GB DGX Spark configuration launching on October 23.

Furthermore, NVIDIA confirmed a Windows release of the high-end DGX Station—featuring 748GB coherent memory—in December to bridge workflows between local AI models and professional manufacturing software. A recent software update also introduces a Wi-Fi Assistant for easier management of DGX Spark in headless appliance modes.

title_zh: 星巴克 10 月 22 日起全国实行「消费入座」，将投入超 3 亿元升级服务
content_zh:
星巴克中国将于 10 月 22 日起在全国实行「消费入座」，门店会摆放相关提示牌。公司表示，会向门店伙伴提供统一服务指引，执行时遵循友好沟通原则，并妥善处理合理的突发需求及特殊情况；遇到孕妇、行动不便者等需要帮助的顾客，会优先给予帮助。

与这项门店空间规则同时公布的，还有新财年服务升级计划。星巴克中国宣布，2027 财年将新增投入超 3 亿元，用于增加高峰时段及臻选吧台人力、升级数智化系统和核心设备，并改造约 1000 家门店。

其中，全国近半数门店将增加高峰时段人力，每月新增超过 20 万小时服务时间，臻选吧台另增超过 7 万小时。新增 70 多项功能的智能移动 POS 机将自 2027 年 1 月起分阶段上线。

服务保障还包括：顾客对饮品不满意可免费重做；下错取单门店时，可凭有效订单由所在门店协助重新制作。
title_en: Starbucks China Implements Customers-Only Seating and Pledges Over 300 Million Yuan for Service Upgrades
content_en:
Starbucks China will enforce a "purchase-to-sit" policy nationwide starting October 22, placing friendly notice signs across its stores. Store staff will receive standardized service guidelines to handle special requests flexibly, with priority assistance given to pregnant women, elderly patrons, and customers with disabilities.

Alongside the new seating rule, Starbucks announced a service upgrade plan exceeding 300 million yuan ($42 million) for fiscal year 2027. The investment will fund peak-hour and Reserve bar staffing, upgrade digital systems, and remodel approximately 1,000 stores nationwide.

Under the plan, nearly half of its Chinese stores will add over 200,000 peak service hours monthly, with Reserve bars receiving an extra 70,000 hours. An upgraded smart mobile POS system featuring over 70 new capabilities will also roll out in phases starting January 2027.

To further boost customer satisfaction, the coffee giant reaffirmed key service guarantees, including free drink remakes if a customer is unsatisfied and assistance in remaking orders accidentally placed at the wrong store location.

title_zh: 美国沃尔玛为 AI 代购设独立档案，用户可限额并随时撤销授权
content_zh:
沃尔玛宣布为 AI 代购推出 Agent Profiles、Agent Gateway 和专门的智能体使用条款，覆盖沃尔玛与山姆会员商店。用户可以选择自己习惯的 AI 应用代买商品，同时单独管理每个智能体的权限。

Agent Profiles 计划在接下来一个月上线。每个智能体将在顾客账号内拥有独立档案，代购订单与本人订单分开显示；用户可要求逐笔确认，也可设定消费限额，并随时关闭授权。

已进入测试的 Agent Gateway 通过 MCP 协议连接智能体与商店系统，让它们直接查找商品和完成购买，减少模拟浏览器操作造成的卡顿和错误。沃尔玛称，系统可帮助智能体找到用户常买的商品，而不必向它披露完整购物历史。

条款禁止智能体超出顾客意图采取行动、修改顾客支付方式或读取任务所不需要的信息，违规智能体将被封禁。

沃尔玛还表示，同一商品面向 AI 智能体与直接购物顾客展示相同价格，适用优惠及费用会在付款前列明。
title_en: Walmart Introduces AI Agent Profiles and Granular Shopping Controls for Automated Buyers
content_en:
Walmart has unveiled a new suite of features—including Agent Profiles, Agent Gateway, and dedicated terms of service—designed to let AI agents shop on behalf of customers across Walmart and Sam’s Club. The system allows shoppers to delegate buying tasks to their preferred AI applications while keeping full control over permissions.

Launching next month, Agent Profiles will assign a distinct identity to each AI agent within a user's account. Agent purchases will be listed separately from personal orders, and users can require per-transaction confirmations, set spending limits, or revoke access at any time.

The retailer is also testing Agent Gateway, built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), to connect AI agents directly to Walmart’s catalog and checkout system. This direct connection reduces lag caused by browser emulation and helps agents locate frequently purchased items without exposing full purchase histories.

Walmart’s updated terms strictly prohibit AI agents from exceeding user intent or harvesting unnecessary data. The company emphasized that AI buyers will see identical pricing, discounts, and fees as human shoppers.

title_zh: 《沙丘 3》内地定档 12 月 31 日
content_zh:
《沙丘 3》宣布将于 12 月 31 日在中国内地上映。IMAX 官方同步发布定档信息，称影片采用 IMAX「特制」拍摄，包含 71 分钟独家画幅，并配以定制混音。

影片由丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导，是其《沙丘》三部曲的最终章，继续围绕保罗·厄崔迪掌握权力后的命运展开。提莫西·查拉梅与赞达亚饰演的保罗、契妮在故事中走向命运的两端，逝去故人的归来也给保罗带来新的谜题。

影片由传奇影业与华纳兄弟探索集团打造，北美定于 12 月 18 日上映。
title_en: 'Dune 3' Sets Mainland China Release for December 31
content_en:
The sci-fi blockbuster *Dune 3* has officially secured a mainland China release date for December 31. IMAX confirmed that the film was shot with IMAX cameras and features 71 minutes of exclusive expanded aspect ratio alongside a custom audio mix.

Directed by Denis Villeneuve, the movie marks the epic conclusion to his *Dune* trilogy. The narrative follows Paul Atreides' complex journey after consolidating power, as Paul (Timothée Chalamet) and Chani (Zendaya) find themselves pulled toward opposing destinies while unexpected returns from the past introduce new mysteries.

Produced by Legendary Pictures and Warner Bros. Discovery, the final chapter will hit North American theaters earlier in the month on December 18.

title_zh: 《欢乐合唱团》将重启，Disney+ 与 Hulu 正式预订新剧
content_zh:
《欢乐合唱团》（Glee）将以新剧回归。Disney+ 与 Hulu 已正式预订重启版，制作方仍是原剧的 20th Television。

据《好莱坞报道者》报道，主创瑞恩·墨菲在 8 月表示考虑重启，并在 9 月透露已与原剧共同创作者布拉德·法尔查克、伊恩·布伦南写好新版本剧本。此次预订公告尚未公布演员和制作团队，相关主创协议仍在敲定。

原剧于 2009 至 2015 年在 Fox 播出，共 6 季，围绕俄亥俄州一所高中的合唱团展开。它把流行歌曲翻唱、校园成长与人物关系结合，曾获得 6 座艾美奖，原版目前可在 Hulu 观看。
title_en: 'Glee' Reboot Officially Ordered by Disney+ and Hulu
content_en:
Hit musical series *Glee* is returning to the screen after Disney+ and Hulu officially ordered a brand-new reboot. The series will once again be produced by 20th Television.

Original co-creators Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk, and Ian Brennan have already scripted the new project. While deal negotiations with the creative team are currently being finalized, casting and production details remain under wraps.

The original *Glee* aired on Fox for six seasons between 2009 and 2015. Centered around an Ohio high school show choir, the culturally impactful series combined pop music covers with coming-of-age drama, earning six Emmy Awards during its run.

title_zh: 汤姆·克鲁斯将获 AFI 终身成就奖，明年 4 月举行致敬典礼
content_zh:
美国电影学会 AFI 宣布，汤姆·克鲁斯将获第 52 届 AFI 终身成就奖。致敬典礼定于 2027 年 4 月 24 日在好莱坞杜比剧院举行，将回顾他的银幕作品及演员、制片人生涯。

AFI 董事会主席凯瑟琳·肯尼迪表示，克鲁斯对电影能够凝聚观众抱有深厚信念，其投入也使他成为美国电影在全球的重要代表。这个奖项每年选出一位获奖者，关注长期创作贡献，以及作品获得同行、评论界与观众认可的程度。

克鲁斯的代表作横跨《壮志凌云》《碟中谍》《雨人》《好人寥寥》和《少数派报告》等。他曾凭《生于七月四日》《甜心先生》获得奥斯卡最佳男主角提名，凭《木兰花》获得最佳男配角提名，并以《壮志凌云：独行侠》制片人身份获最佳影片提名。

他还在 2025 年获得奥斯卡荣誉奖。AFI 近年的获奖者包括妮可·基德曼、弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉和艾迪·墨菲。
title_en: Tom Cruise to Receive 52nd AFI Life Achievement Award
content_en:
The American Film Institute has selected Tom Cruise as the recipient of the 52nd AFI Life Achievement Award. A tribute gala celebrating his decades-long career as an actor and producer will take place at Hollywood's Dolby Theatre on April 24, 2027.

AFI Board Chair Kathleen Kennedy praised Cruise's deep belief in the power of cinema to unite audiences, highlighting his devotion to representing American filmmaking on a global scale.

Cruise's legendary career features iconic roles in films such as *Top Gun*, *Mission: Impossible*, *Rain Man*, *A Few Good Men*, and *Minority Report*. He has earned Oscar nominations for *Born on the Fourth of July*, *Jerry Maguire*, and *Magnolia*, alongside a Best Picture nomination for producing *Top Gun: Maverick*.
